mapper.select: SELECT sd.id, si.id AS soId, si.discount_amount, sd.sku_id, sd.sku_no, sd.qty, sd.price, sd.tax_amount_before, sd.tax_rate FROM so_info si LEFT JOIN so_detail sd ON si.id = sd.main_id AND si.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sd.is_deleted = FALSE AND si.approve_status='approve' AND si.discount_amount>0

SELECT min(si.bill_date) AS soDate, sd.sku_id FROM so_info si INNER JOIN so_detail sd ON si.id = sd.main_id AND si.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sd.is_deleted = FALSE
AND si.id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY sd.sku_id
